audit: iris_bo_map() NULL-return call sites (gem_mmap failure, e.g. BAR/CPU-window exhaustion)
method: grep every iris_bo_map( call site in src/gallium/drivers/iris/; each checked for a NULL check on the return value; the same call site then checked on upstream main (raw git files) to confirm the bug is still present upstream.
upstream_main_status: ALL sites below are STILL unguarded on upstream main (verified against raw main files before cleanup).

sites.risk: staging BO map NULL -> map->ptr unset, later deref
sites.fix: on NULL: destroy staging, map->staging=NULL, return (caller falls back to direct CPU map)

sites.risk: WRITE-side tiled memcpy: dst = res->offset + NULL -> SEGV in isl_memcpy_linear_to_tiled / linear_to_tile4_faster (THE FIELD CRASH in gnome-shell tc_flush)
sites.fix: on NULL: perf_debug 'tiled update dropped', skip the copy

sites.risk: READ-side tiled memcpy: src = res->offset + NULL -> SEGV in isl_memcpy_tiled_to_linear
sites.fix: on NULL: perf_debug, memset map->buffer to zeros

sites.risk: direct map NULL -> map->ptr left NULL, caller derefs
sites.fix: on NULL: perf_debug, leave map->ptr NULL (documented NULL-return contract of pipe texture_transfer)

sites.risk: linear upload dst map NULL -> SEGV in the per-slice memcpy loop
sites.fix: on NULL: fall back to u_default_texture_subdata

sites.risk: alias (gem_handle==0) path: real_map NULL -> map = NULL + offset -> SEGV
sites.fix: on NULL: return NULL

sites.risk: aux map BO map NULL -> buf->map NULL, later deref
sites.fix: on NULL: goto err_free (caller handles NULL return)

sites.risk: debug decode map NULL -> decoder derefs
sites.fix: on NULL: return empty decode-BO struct

sites.risk: debug batch map NULL -> intel_print_batch derefs
sites.fix: if (map) intel_print_batch(...)

sites.risk: command-buffer map NULL -> batch->map NULL, every command write SEGVs
sites.fix: REWORKED to swap pattern: alloc+map the NEW bo before unref'ing the old; on NULL keep the old (still-usable) batch

sites.risk: after unref, batch->bo dangling; create_batch swap would double-unref
sites.fix: batch->bo=NULL after unref; assert(!batch->bo || batch->bo->index==0)

sites.risk: post-reset empty batch -> command writes into NULL map
sites.fix: if (!batch->bo) { perf message; abort(); } (void function, matches the driver's established submission-failure contract)

sites.risk: post-unref dangling batch->bo; create_batch double-unref; *addr = batch->bo->address NULL deref
sites.fix: batch->bo=NULL after unref; if (batch->bo) *addr = batch->bo->address;

sites.risk: unrefs old binder bo BEFORE allocating the replacement; on map failure the binder is left with no bo/map
sites.fix: save old_bo, alloc+map the new bo first; on NULL keep the old binder; only swap on success

sites.risk: pool map NULL -> pool->map NULL, every upload derefs
sites.fix: on NULL: unref bo, pool->bo=NULL, return (pool left empty)

sites.risk: upload on empty pool derefs pool->bo/pool->map
sites.fix: if (!pool->bo) fall back to BC_BLACK (matches the pool-full path)

sites.risk: measure BO map NULL -> base.timestamps NULL, snapshot derefs
sites.fix: on NULL: unref bo, free measure, batch->measure=NULL

sites.risk: unmap/unref of a NULL bo (after the init-failure path)
sites.fix: if (batch->bo) { unmap; unref; }

sites.risk: batch->measure NULL after init failure -> deref
sites.fix: if (!batch->measure) return;

sites.risk: batch->measure NULL after init failure -> deref
sites.fix: if (!batch->measure) return;

sites.risk: utrace BO map NULL -> memset(NULL) SEGV
sites.fix: on NULL: unref bo, return NULL (u_trace framework handles a NULL buffer; the emit path already checks)

notes: iris_utrace_emit_timestamp already had a NULL guard on its map result (line ~130); only create_buffer needed the fix.
The field crash (gnome-shell tc_flush) is the iris_unmap_tiled_memcpy site — the write-side linear_to_tile4 path.
All 22 hunks compile (ninja on the real tree) and the patch dry-runs cleanly against the pristine 26.2.4 source.
